app.home.loading_addons.description: Home: caption beside the spinner while the installed addons' manifests load.

app.home.addons_failed.value: Impossibile caricare i tuoi componenti aggiuntivi
app.home.addons_failed.description: Home: failure verdict when no installed addon could be loaded.

app.home.addons_failed_reason.value: Verifica che il televisore sia connesso, poi riprova.
app.home.addons_failed_reason.description: Home: the line under the addons failure verdict.

app.home.retry.description: Home: the button under the addons failure verdict that asks again.

app.home.nothing.value: I tuoi componenti aggiuntivi non hanno nulla da sfogliare
app.home.nothing.description: Home: read-out when the installed addons offer no catalog to browse.

app.home.row_failed.description: Home: note in place of a catalog row whose first page failed to load; a Try again button follows it.

app.home.row_source.description: Home: a catalog row heading's annotation — the content type and the addon that provides the row.

app.kind.movie.description: A Stremio content type, as a row annotation (plural).

app.kind.series.description: A Stremio content type, as a row annotation (plural).

app.kind.channel.description: A Stremio content type, as a row annotation (plural): video channels.

app.kind.tv.description: A Stremio content type, as a row annotation: live TV.

app.kind.anime.description: A Stremio content type (addon-defined, e.g. Kitsu), as a row annotation and a type filter chip.

app.filter.all.description: Home and Library: the first type filter chip, which shows every content type.

app.nav.home.description: The Home page's name, as the crumb BACK returns to.

app.detail.loading.description: Detail: note while the title's description loads.

app.detail.season.description: Detail: the heading over one season's episodes.

app.detail.specials.description: Detail: the heading over a series' specials (season 0).

app.detail.episodes.description: Detail: the heading over a series' episode list while it loads or when it cannot be shown.

app.detail.episodes_loading.description: Detail: note while a series' episode list loads.

app.detail.episodes_failed.description: Detail: note when a series' episode list failed to load; reason is a short technical cause.

app.detail.no_meta.value: Nessuno dei tuoi componenti aggiuntivi elenca gli episodi di questa serie
app.detail.no_meta.description: Detail: note when no installed addon describes this series' episodes.

app.detail.no_episodes.value: Questa serie non ha ancora episodi
app.detail.no_episodes.description: Detail: note when a series lists no episodes.

app.detail.streams_loading.description: Detail: note under an addon's name while it is asked for streams.

app.detail.streams_failed.value: Questo componente aggiuntivo non ha risposto ({reason})
app.detail.streams_failed.description: Detail: note under an addon's name when it did not answer; reason is a short technical cause.

app.detail.no_streams.value: Nessun flusso da questo componente aggiuntivo
app.detail.no_streams.description: Detail: note under an addon's name when it has no stream for this title.

app.detail.no_stream_addons.value: Nessuno dei tuoi componenti aggiuntivi offre flussi per questo titolo
app.detail.no_stream_addons.description: Detail: note when no installed addon offers streams for this title.

app.detail.streams.description: Detail: the heading over the streams when no addon offers any.

app.detail.not_playable.description: Detail: trailing read-out of a stream this app cannot play (a torrent, a link to another app).

app.detail.stream_cached.description: Detail: chip on a stream the addon's debrid service already holds (it plays at once).

app.detail.stream_uncached.value: Non in cache — avvia un download
app.detail.stream_uncached.description: Detail: quiet chip on a stream the debrid service does not hold yet: playing it starts the download and shows the service's placeholder clip.

app.detail.stream_live.description: Detail: chip on a live stream (a TV channel, an addon's live stream): it has no length and no resume point.

app.detail.stream_seeders.description: Detail: chip with a torrent stream's seeder count.

app.settings.stream_languages.description: Settings: row and page title — the languages whose streams a stream list puts first.

app.settings.stream_languages_copy.value: Gli stream in queste lingue vengono elencati per primi, dopo quelli in cache.
app.settings.stream_languages_copy.description: Preferred audio language picker: the line under the title.

app.settings.stream_languages_same.description: Stream sorting: the row value, and the page's switch, when the order follows the audio languages.

app.settings.audio_languages.description: Settings: row and page title — the ordered languages of the audio track a film starts on.

app.settings.audio_languages_copy.value: Riproduce la prima di queste lingue presente nel file. Nessuna: quella predefinita del file.
app.settings.audio_languages_copy.description: Audio languages page: the line under the title.

app.settings.audio_languages_none.description: Settings: the Audio languages row's value while none is chosen (the file's default track plays).

app.settings.subtitle_languages.description: Settings: row and page title — the ordered subtitle languages.

app.settings.subtitle_languages_copy.value: Mostra la prima di queste lingue disponibile. Nessuna: la lingua dell’app, poi l’inglese.
app.settings.subtitle_languages_copy.description: Subtitle languages page: the line under the title.

app.settings.subtitle_languages_none.description: Settings: the Subtitle languages row's value while none is chosen (the app's language, then English).

app.settings.languages_chosen.description: A language list page: the heading over the chosen languages, in order.

app.settings.languages_add.description: A language list page: the heading over the languages that can be added.

app.settings.languages_none.description: A language list page: the note while no language is chosen.

app.settings.languages_summary.description: Settings: a language row's value for several languages — the first one's name and how many follow it.

app.settings.language_up.description: A chosen language's menu: move it one place earlier.

app.settings.language_down.description: A chosen language's menu: move it one place later.

app.settings.language_remove.description: A chosen language's menu: take it off the list.

app.settings.forced_fallback.description: Settings: row and picker title — whether Forced only also accepts a forced track in a subtitle language.

app.settings.forced_fallback_copy.value: Con Solo forzati: se la lingua dell’audio non ha una traccia forzata, usane una nelle tue lingue dei sottotitoli.
app.settings.forced_fallback_copy.description: Forced fallback picker: the line under the title.

app.settings.forced_fallback_off.description: Forced fallback picker: only the audio language's forced track.

app.settings.forced_fallback_on.description: Forced fallback picker: also a forced track in a subtitle language.

app.settings.subtitle_mode.description: Settings: row and picker title — whether subtitles show when a film starts.

app.settings.subtitle_mode_copy.value: Auto: sottotitoli quando l’audio non è nella tua lingua, altrimenti solo forzati.
app.settings.subtitle_mode_copy.description: Subtitles picker: the line under the title.

app.settings.subs_on.description: Subtitles picker: always show subtitles in the subtitle language.

app.settings.subs_forced.description: Subtitles picker: only forced subtitles (signs, foreign dialogue).

app.settings.subs_auto.description: Subtitles picker: on when the audio is not in the audio language, forced only when it is.

app.settings.next_episode.description: Settings: row and picker title — what plays when an episode ends or Up Next is accepted.

app.settings.next_episode_copy.value: Stessa release mantiene la fonte che stai guardando se ha l’episodio successivo; altrimenti si apre l’elenco degli stream.
app.settings.next_episode_copy.description: Next episode picker: the line under the title.

app.settings.next_same.description: Next episode picker: play the next episode's stream of the same release (shown on the player's Up Next line once found).

app.settings.next_choose.description: Next episode picker: always open the next episode's stream list.

app.detail.upcoming.description: Detail: trailing read-out of an episode whose release date is still ahead.

app.detail.all_episodes.description: Detail: the button on an episode's Streams page that opens the show's page with all its episodes.

app.detail.cast.description: Detail: the line naming a title's leading actors; names is a comma-separated list.

app.detail.director.description: Detail: the line naming a title's directors; names is a comma-separated list.

app.detail.genres_label.description: Detail: the label over a title's genre chips (each opens Discover on that genre).

app.detail.cast_label.description: Detail: the label over a title's cast chips (each searches for that name).

app.detail.director_label.description: Detail: the label over a title's director chips (each searches for that name).

app.detail.summary_label.description: Detail page: the small-caps label over the synopsis (stremio-web's SUMMARY).

app.player.refused.description: Player: the failure read-out when the stream's own request headers cannot be sent (malformed).

app.player.debrid_downloading.value: Download ancora in corso sul tuo servizio debrid: riprova tra qualche minuto
app.player.debrid_downloading.description: Player: the system toast after a debrid service's "still downloading" placeholder clip played out (the torrent is not cached yet).

app.player.audio.description: Player: the audio track menu's title, and the Info panel's audio row.

app.player.subtitles.description: Player: the subtitle track menu's title, and the Info panel's subtitle row.

app.player.subtitles_off.description: Player: the subtitle menu's first row, which shows no subtitles; also the Info panel's subtitle value then.

app.player.subtitle_addon.description: Player: a subtitles addon's subtitle in the subtitle menu — its language and the addon that offers it (both server text).

app.player.subtitle_delay.description: Player: the subtitle menu's delay row and the title of the delay menu.

app.player.subtitle_earlier.description: Subtitle delay menu: show the subtitles a quarter second earlier.

app.player.subtitle_later.description: Subtitle delay menu: show the subtitles a quarter second later.

app.player.subtitle_delay_reset.description: Subtitle delay menu: back to no delay.

app.player.subtitle_languages.description: Player: the subtitle menu's left column header — the languages subtitles are offered in.

app.player.subtitles_embedded.description: Player: the subtitle menu's group of the file's own subtitle tracks, and the mark on such a track among a language's subtitles.

app.player.subtitles_other.description: Player: the subtitle menu's group of addon subtitles that name no language.

app.player.subtitle_forced.description: Player: the mark on a subtitle that only translates foreign dialogue.

app.player.subtitle_sdh.description: Player: the mark on a subtitle for the deaf and hard of hearing (keep it short: a mark, not a phrase).

app.player.subtitle_delay_short.description: Player: the subtitle menu's delay row, under the languages (the menu is the subtitles', so the one word says it).

app.player.seconds.description: Player: a subtitle delay in seconds, signed (+0.25, −1.50).

app.player.more.description: Player: the title of the menu behind the transport's … button.

app.player.show_info.description: Player: the … menu's row that opens what plays, as its catalog tells it (the show, the episode, its overview, cast and director).

app.player.now_playing.description: Player: the Episodes panel's mark on the episode that is playing.

app.player.paused.description: Player: the word under the pause badge in the middle of the picture while the film is paused.

app.player.subtitles_on.description: Player: the note after the green key turned subtitles on; {name} is the subtitle's name (its language, the addon).

app.player.subtitles_turned_off.description: Player: the note after the green key turned subtitles off.

app.player.track.description: Player: a track menu row for a track the file names in no language, by its position.

app.player.next_episode.description: Player: the button near an episode's end that opens the next episode's streams.

app.player.watch_credits.description: Player: the button beside Next episode that keeps watching this one.

app.player.up_next.description: Player: the line over the next episode's name near an episode's end.

app.player.skip_intro.description: Player: the button shown during an episode's intro; OK jumps to its end.

app.player.skip_recap.description: Player: the button shown during an episode's recap of earlier episodes; OK jumps to its end.

app.player.skipped_intro.description: Player: the short notice after the intro was skipped automatically.

app.player.skipped_recap.description: Player: the short notice after the recap was skipped automatically.

app.settings.skip_intros.description: Settings: row and picker title — whether the player offers to skip intros and recaps.

app.settings.skip_off.description: Skip intros picker: never offer to skip.

app.settings.skip_button.description: Skip intros picker: show a Skip intro button (the default).

app.settings.skip_auto.description: Skip intros picker: skip intros and recaps without asking.

app.settings.skip_intros_copy.value: Salta sigle e riassunti quando se ne conoscono i marcatori (introdb.app, AniSkip).
app.settings.skip_intros_copy.description: Skip intros picker: the line under the title. introdb.app and AniSkip are proper names.

app.settings.dv_profile7.description: Settings: row and picker title — how a dual-layer Dolby Vision Profile 7 file plays. 'Dolby Vision' is a trademark, never translated.

app.settings.dv_hdr10.description: Dolby Vision Profile 7 picker: play the HDR10 base layer (the default). HDR10 is a format name.

app.settings.dv_try.description: Dolby Vision Profile 7 picker: experimental — declare Dolby Vision to the TV, falling back to HDR10 automatically.

app.settings.dv_profile7_copy.value: Per i film Dolby Vision a doppio strato. HDR10 funziona su ogni TV; Prova Dolby Vision torna a HDR10 se la TV rifiuta.
app.settings.dv_profile7_copy.description: Dolby Vision Profile 7 picker: the line under the title.

app.settings.multichannel_audio.description: Settings: row and picker title — what a 5.1/7.1 track the app decodes itself is sent to the TV's audio output as.

app.settings.multichannel_auto.description: Multichannel audio picker: the default — Dolby Digital on every sound output (the TV mixes app PCM down to stereo, even over eARC).

app.settings.multichannel_dolby_digital.description: Multichannel audio picker: always Dolby Digital 5.1. 'Dolby Digital' is a trademark, never translated.

app.settings.multichannel_dolby_digital_.description: Multichannel audio picker: always Dolby Digital Plus (E-AC-3) 5.1, for HDMI ARC / eARC. 'Dolby Digital Plus' is a trademark, never translated.

app.settings.multichannel_pcm.description: Multichannel audio picker: always multichannel PCM. PCM is a format name.

app.settings.multichannel_stereo.description: Multichannel audio picker: every surround track downmixed to a plain stereo pair.

app.settings.multichannel_stereo_hint.value: Per altoparlanti TV, cuffie o Bluetooth
app.settings.multichannel_stereo_hint.description: Multichannel audio picker: the line under Stereo — who it is for.

app.settings.multichannel_dplii.description: Multichannel audio picker: every surround track folded to Dolby Pro Logic II matrixed stereo. 'Pro Logic II' is a trademark, never translated.

app.settings.multichannel_dplii_hint.value: Per ricevitori Pro Logic II su un collegamento stereo
app.settings.multichannel_dplii_hint.description: Multichannel audio picker: the line under Pro Logic II — for a receiver that unfolds Pro Logic II, connected by a link that carries stereo only (optical with LG Sound Sync).

app.settings.multichannel_audio_copy.value: Come viene inviato l'audio 5.1 e 7.1 decodificato dall'app. Automatico è Dolby Digital su ogni uscita: il PCM spesso il televisore lo riduce a stereo.
app.settings.multichannel_audio_copy.description: Multichannel audio picker: the line under the title.

app.player.undo.description: Player: the chip after a seek saying that the BACK key returns to {time}, where the seek started. The key's name is in capitals.

app.settings.subtitle_color.description: Settings: row and picker title — the colour text subtitles are drawn in.

app.settings.subtitle_color_copy.description: Text colour picker: the line under the title.

app.settings.subtitle_background.description: Settings: row and picker title — the box drawn behind text subtitles.

app.settings.subtitle_background_copy.value: Un riquadro dietro i sottotitoli, più leggibili sulle scene chiare.
app.settings.subtitle_background_copy.description: Background picker: the line under the title.

app.settings.background_black_50.description: Background picker: a black box at half opacity.

app.settings.background_black_75.description: Background picker: a black box at three-quarter opacity.

app.settings.background_black.description: Background picker: an opaque black box.

app.settings.subtitle_outline.description: Settings: row and picker title — the colour of the edge around text subtitles.

app.settings.subtitle_outline_copy.value: Il bordo attorno a ogni lettera.
app.settings.subtitle_outline_copy.description: Outline colour picker: the line under the title.

app.settings.subtitle_opacity.description: Settings: row and picker title — how opaque text subtitles are drawn.

app.settings.subtitle_opacity_copy.value: Vale per testo, bordo e sfondo.
app.settings.subtitle_opacity_copy.description: Opacity picker: the line under the title.

app.settings.ass_styling.description: Settings: row and picker title — whether ASS/SSA subtitles keep their own styling.

app.settings.ass_styling_copy.value: Attivo mantiene font, colori e posizione della traccia ASS. Disattivo usa il tuo stile.
app.settings.ass_styling_copy.description: Style ASS subtitles picker: the line under the title.

app.settings.auto_play.description: Settings: row and picker title — whether the next episode plays by itself when one ends.

app.settings.auto_play_copy.value: Disattivo: a fine episodio torni da dove eri partito. Il prossimo episodio viene comunque proposto.
app.settings.auto_play_copy.description: Auto-play picker: the line under the title.

app.settings.up_next_at.description: Settings: row and picker title — when the player offers the next episode.

app.settings.up_next_at_copy.value: Ai titoli di coda usa il marcatore dei titoli, oppure 35 s prima della fine.
app.settings.up_next_at_copy.description: Up Next picker: the line under the title.

app.settings.up_next_credits.description: Up Next picker: at the credits marker when known (else 35 s before the end).

app.settings.up_next_15.description: Up Next picker: 15 seconds before the end.

app.settings.up_next_25.description: Up Next picker: 25 seconds before the end.

app.settings.up_next_35.description: Up Next picker: 35 seconds before the end.

app.settings.up_next_45.description: Up Next picker: 45 seconds before the end.

app.settings.language.description: Settings > Interface: the row (and picker title) choosing the language of the app's own text.

app.settings.language_copy.value: Menu e messaggi. Vale dal prossimo avvio.
app.settings.language_copy.description: Interface language picker: the line under the title.

app.player.choose_stream.description: Player failure read-out: the button that returns to the stream list to pick another stream.

app.player.try_again.description: Player failure read-out: the button that starts the same stream again from where it stopped.

app.grid.more_failed.description: Catalog grid/list: the button after the last item when the next page failed to load; pressing it asks again.

app.menu.sign_in_to_add.description: Item menu, signed out: the row that opens sign-in (a library needs an account).

app.reason.timeout.description: A short failure cause in parentheses or after a dot: the request took too long.

app.reason.network.description: A short failure cause: the server could not be reached (no connection, DNS, refused).

app.reason.bad_response.description: A short failure cause: the server answered something the app could not read.

app.reason.cancelled.description: A short failure cause: the request was cancelled.

app.reason.api_error.description: A short failure cause: the Stremio account service answered with error number {code}.

app.detail.why_torrent.value: I torrent non si possono riprodurre qui: configura un servizio debrid in questo addon per ottenere link riproducibili
app.detail.why_torrent.description: Toast when OK is pressed on a torrent stream: this app has no torrent engine; a debrid service in the addon turns torrents into playable links.

app.detail.why_youtube.value: I video di YouTube non si possono riprodurre in questa app
app.detail.why_youtube.description: Toast when OK is pressed on a YouTube stream: the app cannot play YouTube.

app.detail.why_external.value: Questo flusso si apre in un’altra app o sito web, non qui
app.detail.why_external.description: Toast when OK is pressed on a stream that is a link to another app or website.

app.detail.quiet_addons.description: Stream list: the last row, standing for the addons that failed or found nothing; OK shows them and why.

app.detail.still_asking.description: Stream list: the note at the end while some addons have not answered yet; a spinner beside it.

app.player.start_over.description: Player: the pill offered for a few seconds after a playback resumed where the viewer stopped; OK plays it from the beginning.

app.player.tab_tracks.description: Subtitle menu: the tab listing the subtitle tracks to pick from.

app.player.tab_timing.description: Subtitle menu: the tab moving subtitles earlier or later (the delay).

app.player.tab_style.description: Subtitle menu: the tab for the subtitles' look (size, position, colour, outline, background); the same preferences as Settings.

app.player.style_note.description: Subtitle menu, Style tab: the note under the rows — the choices are the app-wide subtitle preferences (also in Settings).

app.player.audio_sync.description: Player audio menu: the row (and the steps' title) moving the sound earlier or later against the picture, for streams whose sound is out of sync.

app.settings.tv_guide.description: Settings: row and picker title — the programme guide Live TV channels show now / next from.

app.settings.tv_guide_copy.value: Mostra cosa va in onda ora e dopo sui canali TV in diretta, da una guida pubblica della regione. I canali sono abbinati per nome.
app.settings.tv_guide_copy.description: TV guide picker: the line under the title.

app.settings.tv_guide_de.description: TV guide picker: a region whose public programme guide is loaded (a country name).

app.settings.tv_guide_at.description: TV guide picker: a region whose public programme guide is loaded (a country name).

app.settings.tv_guide_ch.description: TV guide picker: a region whose public programme guide is loaded (a country name).

app.settings.tv_guide_uk.description: TV guide picker: a region whose public programme guide is loaded (a country name).

app.settings.tv_guide_fr.description: TV guide picker: a region whose public programme guide is loaded (a country name).

app.settings.tv_guide_it.description: TV guide picker: a region whose public programme guide is loaded (a country name).

app.settings.tv_guide_es.description: TV guide picker: a region whose public programme guide is loaded (a country name).

app.live.now.description: Live TV: the programme on air on a channel (its card's caption, the player's line above the title).

app.live.next.description: Live TV: the programme after the one on air (the player's caption under the title).

app.discover.recently_watched.description: Discover, Live TV: the catalog dropdown's first choice — the channels the account watched most recently.
